people.bio_note: Confirmed as the same person previously at Tarbox Family Office (Director, Financial Planning) who left to co-found Luminescent Wealth Management with Trevor Scheid in 2025. Career began in 2003; prior roles include Director of Financial Planning at Tarbox Family Office, Senior Wealth Counselor and Director of Client Experience at Versant Capital Management, and Manager of Investment Operations/Relationship Manager at GenSpring Family Offices. CPA/PFS and CFP, also an Accredited Estate Planner and Chartered Advisor in Philanthropy. Named one of Az Business Magazine's '12 Millennials to Watch' (2019), listed at Versant Capital Management, age 38, noted as president of the Financial Planning Association of Greater Phoenix. In June 2017, while a Senior Wealth Counselor at Versant Capital Management, she was one of 16 CPAs age 40 and under honored by the AICPA with the second annual Personal Financial Planning (PFP) Standing Ovation award, recognized at the AICPA's Advanced Personal Financial Planning Conference (AICPA ENGAGE) in Las Vegas.
people.bio_source: '12 Millennials to Watch' independently confirmed via the original AZ Big Media article (azbigmedia.com/business/business-leaders/newsmakers/12-millennials-to-watch-in-2019/). AICPA Standing Ovation award independently confirmed via Versant Capital Management's own press coverage (versantcm.com/insights/news/standing-ovation-top-young-cpa-personal-financial-planning/ and versantcm.com/insights/news/top-cpa-personal-financial-planning/), corroborated by AICPA's own 2017 press release 'AICPA Announces Standing Ovation Honors in Personal Financial Planning' and syndicated coverage on AdvisorNews.com — no longer solely sourced to the firm's own bio page.
